Pose - Phone Camera Selfie.description:
🕴️ Pose: Phone Camera Selfie
A phone-style selfie angle — device visible in hand, slightly above eye level, casual modern framing.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Pose - Phone Camera Selfie.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Within the selected Portrait Framing, angle the face and shoulders toward an implied handheld lens with one arm extended. Show a phone only when another selected visual trait explicitly defines it; otherwise keep the hand empty and preserve the selected camera distance and crop. Female: shoulders angle away from the lens, neck long. Male: shoulders angle square to the lens, neck set. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own angle.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
